newsitem.title: USA: Georgia revenues rise 3.1 percent in December.
newsitem.headline: Georgia revenues rise 3.1 percent in December.

text.p: Georgia revenues rose to $913.5 million for December, an increase of $27 million or 3.1 percent over December of last year, acting state Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson said Monday.

Collections for the first six months of fiscal 1997 totalled $5 billion, an increase of $387.1 million or 8.4 percent over the same period last year. Most of the increase was in personal and corporate income tax revenues.
